name: Fast Shear-Warp with Runlength Encoding
definition: A fast shear-warp method that uses a runlength-encoded (RLE) volume for each principal axis to skip transparent voxels.
summary: Fast Shear-Warp with Runlength Encoding is a scanline-based volume rendering algorithm that uses run-length encoding to skip transparent voxels and occluded pixels, achieving high performance for parallel projections.
